evidence: CTA «comprobar zona» → formulario (nombre, ciudad, zona, email) y respuesta anunciada en <24 h → demo/asesor de 15 min → validación y cierre de exclusividad territorial →
funnel.note: Basado en información pública previa; no se auditó como cliente.

route: Territory availability [observed] → Fifteen-minute presentation [observed] → Territory agreement [inferred] → Launch [observed] → Seller acquisition [observed] → CRM handoff [observed] → Review [observed]
limitations: Se localizaron 2 negación(es) o disclaimer(s) de garantía; no se clasificaron como garantía positiva.
No se enviaron formularios, no se contactó a la empresa y no se inventaron etapas posteriores al CTA.
No se observó un formulario HTML recuperable; puede cargarse con JavaScript o aparecer después de un CTA.
No se detectó una firma técnica comercial reconocible en scripts, iframes, enlaces o formularios públicos; esto no demuestra que no exista.
No se enviaron formularios ni datos personales.
No se contactó con la empresa.
redVitalia: **Adaptar:** una acción principal inequívoca como “Reserva una llamada”, manteniendo una sola ruta dominante por landing.
**Adaptar:** convertir la reversión de riesgo visible en una condición contractual medible, no en una promesa ambigua.
**Copiar con control:** presentar casos con cliente, periodo, inversión, denominador y resultado; distinguir siempre datos autodeclarados de auditoría independiente.
**Copiar:** responder objeciones de precio, plazo, permanencia y resultados antes del CTA de alto compromiso.

message.headline: Exclusive seller leads for real-estate agencies
message.promise: Generate an exclusive monthly volume of seller leads in a protected territory, with media spend and CRM included.
message.positioning: The service combines niche authority, territory exclusivity and a concrete lead floor for Spanish real-estate agencies.
message.audience: Real-estate agencies · Territories still available · Teams able to contact seller leads quickly

fields: Date and time visible before later booking questions
forms.friction: No time was selected, so later fields were not observed.

funnel.detail: The visitor is invited to check whether the area is still available.
The protected area and commercial option are likely confirmed before launch.
The current page states a maximum launch time of five days.
Meta ads lead to a property valuation flow asking zone, property type and reason.
Qualified leads appear in the CRM and trigger WhatsApp and email alerts.
Results are reviewed every two weeks.

pricing: €980 per month plus VAT, with media spend included
Annual monthly plan: €980 per month with content bonus
CRM base while paused: €49 per month
contract: The client must follow up diligently
guarantee: If 40 minimum leads are not delivered, the period is extended free until completed; false, duplicate or out-of-zone leads are replaced.

contradictions: client-count-drift — The active-customer metric needs one dated definition. — One area referenced 12+ active agencies. — Another referenced 20+ agencies.

lead-volume-copy-error — This materially affects the offer and should be corrected. — The principal offer states 40 exclusive leads. — Another text fragment appeared to say 20 minimum leads per month.
launch-timing-drift — Use the current five-day statement with date. — A prior dataset referenced four days. — The current reviewed page stated five days.
inferences: Territory scarcity is both a real operating constraint and a conversion mechanism. — confidence: high — basis: Exclusivity is central to the offer and the CTA asks visitors to check their zone.
The ROI calculator reduces price resistance by translating leads into possible listings. — confidence: medium — basis: The calculator appears beside explicit price and lead volume.
notObservable: Questions after selecting a Calendly time
limitations: The territory contract was not public.
Case results were not independently audited.

copy: Show price, included media and add-ons together
test: Territory check as the first CTA
Lead guarantee paired with clear client follow-up duties
